cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：智力的
cards.example_en: Chess is an intellectual game my uncle loves.
cards.example_zh: 国际象棋是我叔叔喜欢的智力游戏。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：接待处；前台
cards.example_en: Please leave your key at reception.
cards.example_zh: 请把你的钥匙留在接待处。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.example_en: Visitors come to this region for sweet apples and clean rivers.
cards.example_zh: 游客为了甜苹果和清澈的河流来到这个地方。

cards.scene: 城镇场所 · Places and Buildings
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：地区的
cards.example_en: Our team won the regional final in basketball.
cards.example_zh: 我们队赢得了篮球赛的地区决赛。

cards.example_en: The model bridge was the creation of two students in year nine.
cards.example_zh: 这座桥梁模型是九年级两名学生的创造。

cards.example_en: Our booking at the hotel starts on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们在酒店的预约从星期五开始。

cards.example_en: Horse breeding is important work on that farm.
cards.example_zh: 马匹育种是那座农场的一项重要工作。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：乐意的
cards.example_en: Tom is willing to share his notes before the test.
cards.example_zh: 汤姆乐意在测验前把自己的笔记分享出来。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：有能力的
cards.example_en: She is capable of running the whole project.
cards.example_zh: 她有能力管理整个项目。

cards.example_en: Camping in the rain doesn't appeal to me.
cards.example_zh: 雨中露营对我没有吸引力。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：精神的
cards.example_en: Too little sleep can harm your mental health.
cards.example_zh: 睡眠太少会损害你的心理健康。

cards.example_en: Several students missed the bus because of the rain.
cards.example_zh: 因为下雨，几个学生错过了公交车。

cards.example_en: Nobody should steal food from another student's bag.
cards.example_zh: 谁都不应该从别的同学书包里偷食物。

cards.example_en: The bike theft trial lasted two days in the city court.
cards.example_zh: 这起自行车盗窃案的审讯在市法院持续了两天。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：视觉的
cards.example_en: The visual guide helped me set up the new printer.
cards.example_zh: 这份图解帮我把新打印机装好了。
